name: Dispel Fire
body:
School abjuration [cold, water]; Level druid 5, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, shaman 5

This spell functions as dispel evil, except it surrounds you in a white-blue aura and it affects fire creatures rather than evil ones.
